'''Theovor Mindak''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] in the employ of the rebellious [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Grathan]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. Mindak actively colluded with Grathan and the [[Eagle's network]] and oversaw his own lab within [[Lord Grathan's estate|Grathan's estate]].

Mindak was killed by an [[Cipher Nine|Imperial Agent]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and was survived by his daughter, [[Samara Mindak|Samara]], whom he considered "worthless".<ref name="TORvg" />
